component.name: QSpaceMIDI
component.summary: Map a 3Dconnexion SpaceNavigator to MIDI CC messages

description.p: QSpaceMIDI turns the six degrees of freedom and the two buttons of a 3Dconnexion SpaceNavigator 3D mouse into MIDI control change messages, so the device can drive parameters in Renoise or any other MIDI host.

Every axis has its own control change number, value mode - absolute or one of three relative encodings - and sensitivity. A dead zone filters the resting jitter of the cap, and the axis lock transmits only the axis that is deflected the most, so parameters do not bleed into each other while MIDI mapping.
The device is read directly through evdev, so no proprietary 3DxWare driver is needed. A virtual ALSA sequencer port named QSpaceMIDI is published for the host to connect to.

screenshot.caption: Per-axis CC number, mode and sensitivity

description.p: Adds a monochrome tray icon that KDE recolours to match the panel, instead of the colourful one standing out among the others.

Shows the real state of the two buttons, follows the cap in the meters without the dead zone or the update rate getting in the way, keeps quick flicks and quick taps from being lost, and no longer re-centres an axis that is only being held still.
Fixes 3D mouse detection on Windows, where no device was found at all, and reads the axes and buttons through the report descriptor so that every 3Dconnexion model is decoded correctly.
